Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Electricians annual median?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Electricians ($102,350). Among metros with a published median: Chicago $102,350, Seattle $101,780, Austin $60,390. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Electricians?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Electricians (17,720 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 17,720, Seattle 9,750, Austin 7,340. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Electricians most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (1.17). Published LQs: Austin 1.17, Seattle 0.96, Chicago 0.81.

What is the hourly median for Electricians in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $29.03; Chicago $49.21; Seattle $48.93. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
